name: NAS Electronics
old_description: Electronics manufacturing is our core competency and has been for over thirty years. about:
NAS Electronics operates from Henderson, Nevada, after originating as an idea in the hills of California. The company has been active in electronics manufacturing for over thirty years, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership structure and founder names are not publicly stated.

The shop provides end-to-end electronics manufacturing services including PCB assembly (both turnkey and consignment), final box-build assembly, cable and wire harness assembly, and design-for-manufacturability (DFM) review. It supports quick-turn prototypes as well as multi-year production runs, with in-house AOI and X-ray inspection, and offers both RoHS-compliant lead-free and traditional leaded solder processes. The company cites production of hundreds of thousands of units across its history and serves hundreds of OEMs.

Customers are original equipment manufacturers across North America spanning various electronics sectors. The firm emphasizes long-standing supplier partnerships that yield competitive component pricing.

NAS Electronics positions itself on end-to-end expertise, strong supplier relationships, state-of-the-art facilities, and extensive industry knowledge that aim to expand client capabilities without overhead. A U.S.-based team and a willingness to go the extra mile — such as executive travel to prevent line-down situations — are highlighted as service differentiators.
